title: Sigma86
tagline: A smart vault helping DAOs sell big token bags safely, without crashing the market.
description:
DAOs today hold millions of dollars in their treasuries. But when they want to sell
Large amounts of native tokens to fund their daily operations, they face a big
problem. If they sell everything at once, MEV bots will attack them and drain their
funds. If they sell slowly using a simple linear schedule (TWAP), they lose money
because of regular market volatility.

Sigma86 solves this problem completely. It is a smart DeFi vault powered by an
autonomous off-chain agent. Instead of guessing how to sell, I use institutional
mathematics (the Almgren-Chriss execution model) based on the DAO's actual Value-
at-Risk (VaR) budget. My agent calculates the mathematically perfect selling
schedule to balance market impact and volatility risk. Then, it automatically
executes the swaps on-chain. This ensures that DAOs get the best possible price for
their tokens without any manual headache or risk of getting front-run by bots.
how_its_made:
I built this project using a hybrid architecture: an off-chain brain and a highly
secure on-chain vault.

The off-chain agent is developed in TypeScript and integrated using the Model
Context Protocol (MCP). It acts as the mathematical engine. It takes the DAO's risk
budget, calculates the required trajectory, and generates the exact routing
payloads.

For the on-chain part, I wrote the smart contracts in Solidity and tested them
heavily using Foundry. One very notable hack I implemented was writing the core
execution logic in raw Yul assembly. The vault uses Yul to directly route the swaps
into the Uniswap V3 Mainnet Router. This completely bypasses the standard Solidity
ABI encoding overhead, which saves base gas and ensures my transactions get high
priority in the block.

Finally, I used Chainlink Data Feeds as my ultimate security layer. I intentionally
set the DEX slippage to zero, and instead use an atomic post-trade check against
the Chainlink oracle. If the execution price is bad, the oracle check will
immediately revert the entire transaction. This provides 100% protection against
sandwich attacks without locking user funds.
auto_summary: A Solidity vault and TypeScript agent coordinate scheduled token sales with oracle-based execution checks and local testing scripts.
